title: Секретный заказ у Тимура  (A Secret Order from Timur)

segments.t: Convinced that Chef Barinov is hiding a dark secret, the cooks decide to keep an eye on his every move. Out by the storage room, Barinov pulls supplier Timur aside and demands that he deliver a rare, dangerous delicacy immediately.
Но вы что, шефа не знаете?
Макс, тебя к шефу срочно вызывают.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'Well, that is what he said.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'like this' and finishing on 'to say'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'He would have been joking.' The meaning hinges on 'he' working together with 'would' in spoken Russian.
Но вы что, шефа не знаете?
'Come on, do you guys not know the Chef?' Timur brings out the contrast between 'but' and 'you' in a few short words.
'What, you do not believe me, right?' In Russian, the idea of 'what' flows naturally into 'yes' without extra filler words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Let us follow him and see.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'let's' before landing on 'will keep an eye on it'.
Макс, тебя к шефу срочно вызывают.
'Max, the Chef is calling for you urgently.' Timur brings out the contrast between 'Max' and 'you' in a few short words.
'Well, yes.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'come on' and finishing on 'yes'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'What amazing partridges I set aside.' In Russian, the idea of 'what' flows naturally into 'would keep' without extra filler words.
'You cannot even imagine.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'you' and finishing on 'can you imagine'.
'Timur, I need something very special.' Notice how Russian expresses 'Timur' and 'special' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Come on, you know me.' The meaning hinges on 'come on' working together with 'know' in spoken Russian.
'I can bring you anything at all.' Timur anchors the line on 'I', while 'to bring' completes the thought.
'No, this time I need it right now.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'there is no' before landing on 'any minute'. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Но вы что, шефа не знаете?
Макс, тебя к шефу срочно вызывают.
That wraps up this scene as the cooks decide to spy on Chef Barinov, who meets supplier Timur by the cold storage room to demand an exotic and dangerous ingredient right away. See you next time!
